purpose: Complete the coordinate-only negative control for all four accepted spatial folds.
scientific_question: How much of fold-level proxy ranking can be reproduced from row and column coordinates alone under training-only standardization?

features.standardization: fit mean and population standard deviation on training-role coordinates only
features.polynomial: sklearn PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=false) applied after training-only standardization

evaluation.test_interpretation: descriptive negative control; not an operational predictor and not a causal decomposition

interpretation_boundaries: Coordinates are a spatial-structure negative control, not remote-sensing evidence.
The four folds are subregions of one corridor and are not independent geographic replicates.
A coordinate baseline cannot establish or reject geological signal by itself.
No concealed-fault, new-fault, or environmental causal claim is permitted.
